idea-plugin.name: logxy
idea-plugin.description:
Turn the Run and Debug consoles into a log viewer. logxy shows a run's output as a table of parsed columns (time, level, thread, logger, message) that you can filter, search and follow live, right in the Run and Debug tool windows.

A busy application prints thousands of lines, and the console offers a text search. With logxy you can filter down to the warnings and errors of one logger in the last minute, and see on a timeline where they cluster.

  • Formats detected for you. Log4j, logback, Spring Boot, Python logging and more are recognised from the first lines. For a format logxy doesn't know, it infers a parser from the lines themselves. You can also define your own with a pattern, a regex or a JSON key mapping, or save a detected one and adjust it.
  • Visual filters. Combine conditions on any column in all / any / none groups: contains, wildcards, regular expressions, case-sensitive matching, level and time ranges. Right-click a cell to copy it or filter by its value. Save filters for later.
  • Row highlights. Give the rows a query matches a background colour, in every log you open, to spot them without filtering the rest away.
  • Bookmarks. Bookmark records to come back to, with the IDE's Toggle Bookmark key or the row menu, and step through them. They stay through a reload and a filter, and show on the time histogram.
  • Time histogram. Record volume with warnings and errors over time, and where search matches fall. Click to jump there, drag to narrow to a time range.
  • Templates. logxy groups lines that are the same message with different values: Request 4711 done in 12 ms and Request 4712 done in 230 ms are both Request {1} done in {2} ms. The Templates panel lists these message kinds with how often each occurs, so you can show or hide a whole kind at once, and chart a value, such as the duration, over time.
  • Out of the way. A logxy tab beside the Console tab, in Run and in Debug. Each run configuration remembers whether you last looked at logxy, and the columns you hide and resize. The IDE's console stays one click away, for stack-trace links and typing into the program.

Works in IntelliJ IDEA and other IntelliJ-based IDEs from 2025.3, for any run configuration that starts a process. Parsers, saved filters and log levels are set in Settings › Tools › logxy.

logxy is also a desktop app, fast and memory-efficient on large logs, with merging of several files into one.
